tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Main content background: lists, forms, the editor.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The toolbar and bars along the bottom of a view.

tokens.name: tabstrip
tokens.usage: The workspace tab strip behind inactive tabs.

tokens.name: inspector
tokens.usage: The inspector on the right: Agent and Resource.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Behind the plan graph and topology, with a dot grid in hairline.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders of controls, cards, the toolbar and panes.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Rules between rows and sections inside a pane.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface; 11:1 or more.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, timestamps; 4.5:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action colour: the default button fill, the active segment marker, badges. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (6.1:1 light, 4.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links, the focus ring and accent-coloured text on surfaces; 4.9:1 or more.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the current item in a menu, a selected graph node's fill.

tokens.name: create
tokens.usage: Plan: will be created. Always with +. Also good status, with ✓.

tokens.name: create-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of a node or row that will be created.

tokens.name: update
tokens.usage: Plan: updated in place. Always with ~. Also needs attention.

tokens.name: update-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of a node or row that will be updated.

tokens.name: replace
tokens.usage: Plan: destroyed then created. Always with -/+.

tokens.name: destroy
tokens.usage: Plan: will be destroyed. Always with -. Also errors and broken status, with !.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Editor: block types and keywords.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Editor: strings.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Editor: numbers, booleans and CIDR blocks.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: The platform's own UI font. No web font is loaded.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The title of a view or a card.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and emphasis inside a pane.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I added nat.tf and planned it.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Group labels in menus and lists. Sentence case, never all caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pane padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margins on organisation pages.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, graph nodes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers, the commit sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count badges and status pills.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields and segments. Meets WCAG 2.2 target size (24px); desktop pointer app.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: The inspector on the right.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The sidebar on the left.
